purpose: Teach: 西郷/母性/強まる/デリケート/青く/突っ込む/打ち込む/兼ね備え

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 地方支店、本気で、絶対、西郷、絶対、地区、絶対、展開、絶対、検討しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: I need the local branch—the Saigo district especially—to explore expansion seriously. This isn't negotiable.
lines.style: Clipped, authoritative opening. Each clause lands with weight. Steady eye contact. No room for misinterpretation. The tone of someone who expects action, not discussion.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新製品、本気で、絶対、母性、絶対、本能、絶対、訴える、絶対、コンセプト、絶対、好評です、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. The new product is performing well—its maternal appeal and emotional resonance really resonate with customers. We're grateful for your direction.
lines.style: Clear, measured recitation of facts. Slight lift at 'performing well' to show pride in the team. Respectful but not obsequious. Warm professional tone.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 競争が、本気で、絶対、強まる、絶対、業界、絶対、当社、絶対、差別化を、絶対、進めろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Competition is intensifying across the industry. We need to move faster on differentiation—ours is the only edge we have.
lines.style: Firm, forward-leaning. Slight tension in the delivery. Not angry, but impatient. The words come with clarity—each one chosen. Short pauses between clauses.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お客様の、本気で、絶対、デリケート、絶対、な要望、絶対、丁寧に、絶対、対応しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're handling customer requests with care—especially the sensitive ones. Every interaction reflects our commitment.
lines.style: Steady confidence. Emphasis lands on 'care' and 'every interaction.' Shows he understands the weight of what Hiroshi just said. No defensiveness, just assurance.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 新製品の、本気で、絶対、青く、絶対、輝く、絶対、パッケージ、絶対、お洒落な、絶対、デザインにしろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: The new product packaging needs to be distinctive—something elegant with that signature blue. Make it something people notice.
lines.style: Directive but specific. Visual language ('blue,' 'elegant') comes with warmth—he's picturing it. Leaning slightly forward. The tone of someone who has taste and wants it executed well.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新市場に、本気で、絶対、突っ込む、絶対、決断、絶対、当社、絶対、慎重に、絶対、検討しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. We're moving thoughtfully into new markets—we're considering every angle before we commit. It's a deliberate approach.
lines.style: Calm, measured assurance. Shows he's listening to the caution in Hiroshi's earlier point about competition. Slightly slower pace. The words carry weight—he's not rushing this.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 社員、本気で、絶対、業務に、絶対、打ち込む、絶対、環境、絶対、整えろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Create an environment where people want to throw themselves into their work. That matters more than you might think.
lines.style: Quieter, more reflective than previous directives. Pause before 'That matters.' This is personal conviction showing through. Steady, unhurried. The voice of someone who means what he's saying.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。経験と若さを、本気で、絶対、兼ね備えた、絶対、社員、絶対、採用、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're actively recruiting—people who have experience but still have that hunger and energy. That combination is rare and it's what we need.
lines.style: Genuine warmth mixed with professional precision. Slight emphasis on 'rare'—showing he gets why this matters. Confident close. The tone of someone wrapping up a conversation that went well.
